name: Jimmy's No. 44 House
storyline:
You received a strange phone call from someone whose voice sounded odd. He called himself Uncle Jimmy and challenged you. You quickly accepted the challenge because you are a brave person.
After arriving at the location, you passed out. As your consciousness slowly returned, the only thing you could hear was the lingering melody of "Clair de Lune" in your ears. The place was a red building, with little decoration — more like a temporary structure. You were like a little white mouse, searching around inside.
Eight minutes later, you heard an alarm and felt instinctively that something bad was happening.
summary: This is an exciting escape room game. Uncle Jimmy has challenged you and invited you to his house to play a game. Let's see who can survive until the end — whether you escape alive first or get mercilessly killed by him. Hurry and find the puzzle-solving items to escape from this house!
